name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for stucco installation?
description: Choose a stucco contractor based on their experience, licensing, insurance, references, and a detailed proposal that includes warranties and proper installation

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for stucco installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a stucco contractor, look for experience specifically with cement stucco and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify they are licensed, insured, and bonded. Ask for references and check online reviews. Ensure they provide a detailed, written proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and warranty. A good contractor will also explain their process for substrate preparation, moisture management, and crack prevention, demonstrating their commitment to quality installation practices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a stucco contractor based on their experience, licensing, insurance, references, and a detailed proposal that includes warranties and proper installation practices.
